ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.

These are bounded by high-contrast black pigmentation along the entire perimeter, including the leading edges, trailing edges, and tips. A distinct horizontal black linear segment is located in the mid-section of the left lobe white region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jagged indentation and loss of marginal tissue observed on the trailing edge immediately adjacent to the right of the median notch.
